sv.title: Detta händer tisdag 24 november
sv.summary: Det kurspressade fastighetsbolaget SBB väntas öppna böckerna under morgonen. Senare under tisdagen bekänner också investmentbolaget Lundbergs färg.

en.title: This happens Tuesday 24 November
en.summary: The property company SBB, under pressure on the share price, is expected to open its books in the morning. Later on Tuesday, the investment company Lundbergs will also show its colours.
